question: Is current-main source coverage enough to close this Discord/MiMo reasoning leak, or should closure wait for redacted live Discord plus MiMo payload proof?
rationale: The source and tests now cover the structured `reasoning_content` case, but the reported release path is security-sensitive and still lacks end-to-end proof through the custom provider and Discord delivery.

options.title: Require live proof before close
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer captures a redacted current-main Discord/MiMo run proving the hidden-reasoning boundary end to end.

options.title: Close as current-main fixed
options.body: Close the issue against the unreleased current-main mitigation if maintainers accept source-only provider and Discord evidence as sufficient.

options.title: Backport before close
options.body: Treat the current-main mitigation as likely correct but keep the issue open until a release or backport includes it.
